mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, product_id, product_type, begin_quantity, task_quantity, in_production_quantity, complete_quantity, month
mapper.select: SELECT mbp.`name`, mbtp.sequence, SUM(a.inspection_quantity) inspection_quantity FROM mes_building_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process mbtp ON a.task_process_id = mbtp.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON a.process_id = mbp.id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND a.bool_handle_enum = false AND a.product_id = #{productId} AND a.product_type = #{productType} AND DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') <= #{dateTime} GROUP BY a.process_id, mbp.`name`, mbtp.sequence ORDER BY mbtp.sequence
